findings.evidence: Lines 73–139 use only `Scheme`, structure-sheaf sections, `IsSMulRegular`, and `Flat`; `TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/Scheme/Opens.lean` explicitly houses general open-section facts, while `Morphisms/Flat/StructureSheaf.lean` houses general structure-sheaf results involving flat morphisms.
findings.fix: Move the affine-open restriction lemma to `AlgebraicGeometry/Scheme/Opens.lean` and the regularity/flat-pullback results to an appropriate general structure-sheaf or flat-morphism module; publicly import those modules here.
findings.issue: The public declarations at lines 73–139 (`Scheme.isSMulRegular_map_of_forall_affineOpens`, `Scheme.forall_affineOpens_map_of_le`, both flat-pullback lemmas, and `Scheme.isSMulRegular_ΓSpecIso_inv`) mention no effective Cartier divisor or ideal sheaf, so placing them in this specialized module makes their API undiscoverable and forces unrelated consumers through the divisor dependency.

summary: General structure-sheaf and flatness infrastructure is exposed from the effective-Cartier-divisor module instead of its canonical general-purpose homes.
